truth.description: htmlEnvHook now runs JSON.parse on every string value of an import.meta.env key in the resolved config.define, but @vitejs/plugin-legacy puts the bare identifier __VITE_IS_LEGACY__ there for import.meta.env.LEGACY in every client build, so buildHtmlPlugin throws a JSON SyntaxError while the config resolves and every vite build that uses plugin-legacy fails.

distractions.why: The class attribute env-%VITE_FOO% is replaced along with the text, so the paragraph carries the env-bar class and the selector finds it.
